newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London flat on election gloom.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London flat on election gloom.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were little changed from Tokyo's closing levels on Monday as wary investors held off to assess Sunday's lower house elections and to see if Wall Street maintained record levels.

In London, the Nikkei/ISE 50 index was up 2.55 points at 1,453.81. In Tokyo, Nikkei 225 Average closed 309.35 points lower at 21,302.95 amid disappointment the business-friendly Liberal Democratic Party failed to win a majority.
"It's been very quiet today and some disappointment after the elections...now we're looking to see if Wall Street holds up," one dealer in London said.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average set its 31st record of the year on Friday and opened little changed on Monday.

Dealers said Japanese stocks in London were flat across the board and likely to take their cue from New York. But they warned the London market was likely to come under pressure amid expectations the Nikkei 225 Average could be poised to drift down to 21,000 points in the next session.
